related.title: Certificate Transparency：Merkle 證明與監測界線
related.titleEn: Certificate Transparency: Merkle proofs and monitoring boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：16組皆有雙向結果，未授權但有效憑證仍拒絕；任何輸出不包含私鑰。 交付雙向驗證矩陣、離線驗證參數範例與授權對照表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All 16 cases include both directions, valid-but-unauthorized certificates are rejected, and outputs contain no private keys. Deliver mutual-verification tests, offline verification parameter examples and a separate authorization map.
related.difference: 用32筆虛構葉節點畫平衡二元樹，標出葉序、左右方向與根；另將SCT承諾、包含證明與跨樹頭一致性分開。
related.differenceEn: Draw a balanced binary tree of 32 fictional leaves, labeling order, left/right direction and root; distinguish an SCT promise, inclusion proof and consistency across tree heads.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: mTLS建立兩個方向的認證，授權仍需獨立決定；完整測試矩陣數為客戶端×服務×用途狀態。 基準3客戶端、2服務、2種EKU狀態；每一組指定允許或拒絕及原因。 3×2×2=12組；加入第4個客戶端後4×2×2=16組。
對2的整數次方葉數，單葉包含路徑需要log2(N)個兄弟雜湊；證明驗證依順序組合，不能將所有雜湊任意排序。 N=32，每個雜湊32位元組，只計路徑雜湊，不含簽章、索引與樹頭。 log2(32)×32=160位元組；N=64時6×32=192位元組。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: mTLS authenticates in both directions but authorization remains separate; complete tests equal clients×services×purpose states. Baseline uses 3 clients, 2 services and 2 EKU states; each combination has an expected decision and reason. 3×2×2=12 combinations; adding a fourth client gives 4×2×2=16.

For a power-of-two leaf count, a single-leaf path uses log2(N) sibling hashes; verification combines them in order, not arbitrary sorted order. N=32 and each hash is 32 bytes; count path hashes only, excluding signatures, indices and tree heads. log2(32)×32=160 bytes; N=64 needs 6×32=192 bytes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IPv6 RA Guard：鄰居探索與必要控制流量
related.titleEn: IPv6 RA Guard: neighbor discovery and required control traffic
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：16組皆有雙向結果，未授權但有效憑證仍拒絕；任何輸出不包含私鑰。 交付雙向驗證矩陣、離線驗證參數範例與授權對照表。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: All 16 cases include both directions, valid-but-unauthorized certificates are rejected, and outputs contain no private keys. Deliver mutual-verification tests, offline verification parameter examples and a separate authorization map.
related.difference: 畫出24個接入埠與2個授權路由器埠；逐埠測RA、NS/NA與必要錯誤通知，不使用「全部封鎖ICMPv6」代替設計。
related.differenceEn: Map 24 access ports and two authorized router ports; test RA, NS/NA and required error notifications per port instead of blocking all ICMPv6.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: mTLS建立兩個方向的認證，授權仍需獨立決定；完整測試矩陣數為客戶端×服務×用途狀態。 基準3客戶端、2服務、2種EKU狀態；每一組指定允許或拒絕及原因。 3×2×2=12組；加入第4個客戶端後4×2×2=16組。
端口測試數=(接入埠+路由器埠)×封包類別數；允許RA的埠與允許鄰居探索的埠集合不相同。 24個接入埠、2個路由器埠、3類合成控制封包；每類固定一個正常樣本。 (24+2)×3=78案；接入埠增至48而其餘不變時為150案。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: mTLS authenticates in both directions but authorization remains separate; complete tests equal clients×services×purpose states. Baseline uses 3 clients, 2 services and 2 EKU states; each combination has an expected decision and reason. 3×2×2=12 combinations; adding a fourth client gives 4×2×2=16.

Port tests equal (access+router ports)×packet classes; ports allowed to send RA are not the same set as ports needing neighbor discovery. There are 24 access ports, two router ports and three synthetic control-packet classes, with one normal fixture per class. (24+2)×3=78 tests; 48 access ports with other conditions fixed require 150.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
